title: Prosecutors move to dismiss Reflecting Pool vandalism case, saying 'botched installation' to blame
description: The government had accused David Hearn of ripping a piece of sealant after a $14-million renovation. Hearn has repeatedly said that he simply touched the water in the pool out of curiosity last month.

title: Trump says he ended their careers. Now these GOP lame ducks are defying him.
description: GOP Sens. John Cornyn (Texas) and Thom Tillis (North Carolina) are blocking Todd Blanche’s nomination to become attorney general.

title: The next abortion battle is over Kansas’s highest court
description: Voters will decide whether to replace a nearly 70-year-old appointment system with direct elections that could reshape the state Supreme Court for decades.

title: Trump announced a deal for Hamas to disarm. And, the U.S. economy slowed a bit
description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.

title: Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination to circumvent GOP holdouts
description: President Trump says he's willing to hold his nomination of Attorney General Todd Blanche until January, when he says he'll have an easier political calculation in the Senate.

title: Former Sen. Flake on what GOP objections over Blanche's nomination means for Trump
description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Republican U.S. Sen. Jeff Flake what the GOP standoff over Todd Blanche's nomination suggests about the president's hold over his party in Congress.

title: Ahead of midterms, Republicans run ads after cutting healthcare funds
description: Blanketing the airwaves with ads about healthcare, Republican candidates who voted to cut federal funding in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act are positioning themselves as advocates for lower costs.

title: Trump's claims of 250,000 non-U.S. citizens on voter rolls leave some states baffled
description: Trump officials say they found 250,000 noncitizens on voter rolls in just four states. Those states don't know where the numbers came from, and some worry what the claims may portend for the midterms.

title: Democrats show divisions on Israel amid competitive midterm elections
description: Democratic socialists are on the ballot in high profile races coming up in Michigan and Wisconsin, putting mainstream Democrats in a tough position when it comes to the issue of Israel and Gaza.

title: Trump’s claims of election interference in doubt after release of declassified intelligence
description: Declassified evidence points to Beijing seeking personal data for espionage, not election interference.

title: After Fauci Senate hearing, experts worry about 'chilling effect' on public health
description: The accusations against Dr. Anthony Fauci, once the nation's leading infectious disease expert, have some experts worrying that these events may further erode public health staffing in the U.S.

title: Trump's attorney general pick hits resistance from Republicans
description: Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination has run into resistance from Republicans demanding answers about a Justice Department settlement tied to Trump's tax returns.

title: The Trump administration wants $10 million more to cover its July Fourth celebrations
description: Congress allocated $150 million for 250th birthday events. The Trump-backed group that planned the state fair and July 4th fireworks is asking for an additional $10 million in reimbursements.
